review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Database Engineer based in United States . As a Principal Database Engineer, you will shape the architecture, reliability, and long-term evolution of critical database infrastructure supporting high-demand financial services. You will assess complex production environments, define technical direction, and lead the delivery of improvements that strengthen performance, scalability, and operational resilience. Working hands-on with MariaDB and complementary data technologies, you will guide challenging migrations, resolve complex incidents, and develop automation for safer database operations. Diagnose complex MariaDB performance issues and failures across database engines, storage systems, and application layers. Improve production reliability through observability, safer change management, and tested backup, restoration, and disaster recovery procedures. Establish recovery objectives with service owners and validate them through practical recovery exercises. Build and maintain production software and automation for database provisioning, upgrades, failover, online schema changes, and routine maintenance. Develop secure, auditable self-service database workflows in partnership with Security and Compliance teams. Advise application teams on schema design, transaction boundaries, query optimization, and appropriate data-store choices. Mentor engineers through design reviews, technical collaboration, pairing, and incident analysis, encouraging ownership and stronger database expertise. Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, ensuring clear operational ownership and continuous improvement based on production lessons. Requirements At least 8 years of experience operating and evolving large-scale production database environments, including assessing existing systems, defining technical direction, and delivering measurable improvements. Deep, recent, hands-on expertise with MariaDB, particularly InnoDB, MVCC, transaction isolation, locking, query optimization, binary logs, and MariaDB GTID replication. Strong understanding of high availability, replication, distributed database failure modes, consistency and availability trade-offs, transaction boundaries, and reliable event delivery patterns such as transactional outbox. Proven experience independently diagnosing MariaDB incidents, tuning performance, and executing tested restore or point-in-time recovery procedures while validating data integrity. Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, Rust, or a comparable programming language. Experience personally developing and maintaining production software or automation for database provisioning, failover, online schema changes, and self-service operations. Familiarity with version control, code reviews, delivery pipelines, and robust failure-handling practices. Strong knowledge of Linux internals, operating system kernels, storage, and networking, with the ability to investigate issues beyond the database layer. Excellent written communication and technical judgment, with a demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and deliver cross-team initiatives without direct reporting authority. Proven ability to mentor experienced engineers and support sound technical and lifecycle decisions. Nice to have: Experience with containerized, hybrid on-premises and cloud, or multi-region database environments, including Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and GitOps. Nice to have: Familiarity with database proxies and load-balancing technologies such as MaxScale, HAProxy, or ProxySQL. Nice to have: Experience with PostgreSQL, Vitess, TiDB, ScyllaDB, ClickHouse, or internal database platforms, as well as Kafka, Redis/Valkey, or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. Nice to have: Experience working in regulated environments or contributing to database engines, operators, and infrastructure software. You will apply your expertise in cable systems, routing, duct bank configurations, manhole placement, and electrical calculations to deliver safe, reliable, and cost-effective solutions. Develop project design criteria, cost analyses, routing strategies, and solutions to complex siting and right-of-way challenges. Determine appropriate manhole locations and develop physical design configurations for underground transmission systems. Prepare duct bank layouts, trenchless installation designs, cable-pulling calculations, and detailed engineering drawing packages. Conduct cable selection studies, determine bonding configurations, and perform ampacity calculations. Develop riser structure configurations and assess associated structural loading requirements. Prepare technical specifications for cable procurement, duct bank construction, trenchless installations, and general construction activities. Coordinate with vendors and clients to define and specify underground transmission line components and equipment. Review right-of-way requirements, bonding schemes, plan and profile drawings, and other construction documentation. Perform and review engineering calculations, ensuring supporting technical documentation is accurate and complete. Develop cost estimates and project schedules while helping ensure delivery within established budget and timeline constraints. Apply relevant engineering codes, industry standards, EPRI recommendations, and client requirements throughout the design process. Experience developing engineering designs that incorporate applicable codes, EPRI recommendations, and client specifications. Background in cost estimation, project schedule development, and coordination. Strong understanding of engineering design principles, techniques, tools, and practices used to develop technical plans, drawings, and models.
